articles.title: How do I join a queue?
articles.intro: A queue ticket tracks your place in a live line at a business.
steps: Open the business’s GetPrio page or scan its queue QR code.
Choose an available location or service when asked, then review any fee and entry requirements shown.
Enter the requested details and complete the verification or payment steps on screen.
Keep the ticket page or its link so you can check your latest status.
articles.note: A queue is for same-day service. It is not the same as a scheduled booking. A ticket is created only after any required verification and payment steps succeed.

articles.title: Track your turn
articles.intro: Your ticket page is the best place to check the latest queue status.
steps: Open the ticket link you received after joining.
Review the status, position, estimated wait, and any instructions shown by the business.
Keep checking the ticket page as the queue moves.
articles.note: Wait estimates can change as service takes more or less time than expected. Follow the business’s instructions when your ticket is called.

articles.title: Cancel a queue ticket
articles.intro: If you no longer need your place, check whether cancellation is available on your ticket.
steps: Open your queue ticket.
If the ticket offers Cancel, review the confirmation and complete it.
If the action is unavailable or the ticket has already been called, contact the business for help.
articles.note: A queue cancellation does not automatically refund a separate payment. Keep the ticket and payment references if you need to ask about a charge.

articles.title: What happens if the queue closes before my turn?
articles.intro: Some waiting tickets can continue to a later queue day.
steps: Check your ticket for a pending carry-over status and its expiry information.
When the business opens a later queue day, reopen the same ticket link to follow your status.
If the ticket expires or the status is unclear, contact the business.
articles.note: Carry-over is limited and does not apply to every ticket outcome. A ticket that was called, skipped, or reached another final status may not continue.

articles.title: Queue email and browser notifications
articles.intro: Use your ticket page as the source of truth, even when notifications are enabled.
steps: Keep the ticket link available and check it for current status.
If the ticket offers browser notifications, allow them in your browser or device settings.
If a notification does not arrive, reopen the ticket page and check browser permissions.
articles.note: Email and browser notifications can be delayed, blocked, or unavailable on a device. A notification is not a substitute for the latest ticket status.

articles.title: Request a booking
articles.intro: A booking is a request for a scheduled service at a selected business.
steps: Open the business profile and choose an available service and location.
Choose an available date and time, and review the price and payment instructions.
Enter the requested contact details and submit the request.
Follow the booking status; wait for confirmation before treating the visit as confirmed.
articles.note: A booking request is separate from a same-day queue ticket. Available services and times depend on the business’s settings.

articles.title: Understand booking status and check-in
articles.intro: Use the booking details page to see whether your request is pending, confirmed, or needs action.
steps: Open your booking from your account or the booking link.
Read the current status and any message or next step shown.
For a confirmed visit, follow the business’s check-in instructions and arrive within the stated window.
articles.note: A confirmed booking does not automatically place you in the live queue. The business may check you in when you arrive.

articles.title: Change or cancel a booking
articles.intro: Available actions depend on the booking’s status and the business’s terms.
steps: Open the booking and review the actions currently available.
Read any timing, payment, or cancellation information before confirming.
Contact the business if you need a different time or cannot find the action you need.
articles.note: Account deletion does not automatically cancel a booking. Review the current terms before cancelling or asking about a refund.

articles.title: Paying for a booking
articles.intro: Some businesses ask for payment before they confirm a booking.
steps: Review the amount and payment instructions shown for the selected service and location.
If the business requests manual payment, pay using the destination it provides outside GetPrio.
Submit the requested reference and proof through the booking page.
Check the booking page for the business’s decision; submitting proof is not the same as payment verification.
articles.note: GetPrio records the payment information shown in the booking flow but does not settle a manual transfer for the business. Never share a password or one-time sign-in code as payment proof.

articles.title: Ask about a refund
articles.intro: Start with the business that received your booking payment.
steps: Open the booking and note its reference, status, and payment details.
Contact the business and explain what happened, including relevant dates.
If the issue is with GetPrio or the booking page, contact GetPrio and include the business and booking reference.
articles.note: Manual booking refunds are handled by the business, not automatically by GetPrio. Eligibility depends on the current terms and booking circumstances.

articles.title: I can’t sign in
articles.intro: Use the sign-in page’s recovery options and the email address linked to your account.
steps: Check the email address and password you entered.
If you forgot your password, use the password reset option on the sign-in screen.
If asked for a verification code, use one of the methods enabled for your account.
If the problem continues, contact GetPrio and describe the error without sending your password or code.
articles.note: Never share a password, authenticator code, email OTP, or recovery code with anyone offering support.

articles.title: Change your password and secure your account
articles.intro: You can manage your password and sign-in verification from your account security settings.
steps: Sign in and open your account’s Password and authentication settings.
Use Change password to set a new password after completing the requested verification.
Review the multi-factor options available to your account and keep recovery codes somewhere safe if they are provided.
articles.note: Do not reuse a password you use elsewhere. GetPrio support will never ask you to provide a verification code or recovery code.

articles.title: Use email OTP for sign-in verification
articles.intro: If Email OTP is enabled for your account, GetPrio can send a one-time sign-in code to your account email.
steps: Open Password and authentication in your account settings.
Choose the Email OTP option and complete the requested verification to enable it.
During sign-in, enter the code sent to your account email. If an authenticator app is also enabled, the sign-in screen may offer Send email OTP instead.
articles.note: A code expires and should be used only on the GetPrio sign-in screen. If you do not receive it, check the account email and spam folder, then use the on-screen resend option.

articles.title: Request account deletion
articles.intro: You can submit an account deletion request from your account settings.
steps: Sign in to the account you want to delete.
Open Account details and choose the account deletion option.
Read the effects and any outstanding activity notice, then confirm the request.
Use the request status or follow-up email for updates.
articles.note: Deleting an account does not automatically cancel bookings, return payments, or remove records that must be retained for a documented legal or operational reason. Vendors may need additional business-record review. See the Privacy Policy for more information.

articles.title: Manage account and browser notifications
articles.intro: Notification preferences and device permissions are separate settings.
steps: Open Browser notifications or notification settings in your account.
Choose the available preferences and save your changes.
For browser alerts, also allow notifications in the browser or device settings.
articles.note: Email account and security messages may still be sent when needed. Browser alerts require supported browser permissions and may not be delivered when blocked or unavailable.

articles.title: Set up your business profile
articles.intro: Complete your business details so customers know where to go and what to expect.
steps: Finish the business onboarding and approval steps shown in your dashboard.
Review your public profile, locations, services, contact details, and operating hours.
Check location-specific settings, including payment instructions where applicable.
Preview the public pages before sharing their links or QR codes.
articles.note: Available features depend on your approval status, role, and subscription plan. Keep public business information current.

articles.title: Open and manage a queue day
articles.intro: Store hours make a queue day eligible, but an authorized team member opens it.
steps: Check that the location’s hours and queue settings are correct.
Open the queue day from the vendor dashboard when service is ready to begin.
Use the queue controls to call the next customer and process ticket statuses.
Review the queue before closing; follow the dashboard prompts for any remaining tickets.
articles.note: Pausing new joins is different from closing the queue. Existing tickets may still need attention after intake is paused.

articles.title: Invite staff and choose access
articles.intro: Give each team member the role they need for their work.
steps: Open staff management in the vendor dashboard.
Invite a team member using their account email.
Choose an available role and review the access summary before sending the invitation.
Ask the person to follow the invitation email to finish joining the workspace.
articles.note: Access varies by role. Staff operational views do not necessarily include owner-only billing or account controls.

articles.title: Understand plan capacity and usage
articles.intro: Your dashboard shows the capacity available for queue tickets, notifications, and bookings.
steps: Open the billing or capacity view in your vendor dashboard.
Check each feature’s current usage and reset information separately.
If capacity is exhausted, review the options displayed for your plan or contact your account owner.
articles.note: A queue ticket limit, email-notification capacity, and booking allowance are separate. Existing work may continue even when new activity is limited.

articles.title: Contact GetPrio support
articles.intro: A clear description helps us understand an account or app problem.
steps: Use the Contact page or the support address listed there.
Include what you were doing, what you expected, what happened, and when.
Add the business name and booking or ticket reference if relevant.
Remove passwords, one-time codes, full payment details, and unrelated personal information from screenshots.
articles.note: For a visit, schedule, or business decision, contact the business directly. GetPrio support can help with platform and account issues.

articles.title: Report abuse or a safety concern
articles.intro: Use the report option available on the relevant GetPrio page, or contact support if you cannot access it.
steps: Identify the business, booking, ticket, campaign, or content involved.
Describe the specific behavior and when it happened.
Include only evidence relevant to the report and remove unrelated personal data.
If there is immediate danger, contact local emergency services first.
articles.note: Submitting a report asks GetPrio to review it; it does not guarantee a particular moderation outcome.

faqs.question: Is a queue ticket the same as a booking?
faqs.answer: No. A queue ticket tracks your place in a live line. A booking is a request for a scheduled service. A confirmed booking may be checked into a queue by the business.

faqs.question: Is my estimated wait time guaranteed?
faqs.answer: No. It is an estimate based on queue information and can change. Check your ticket and follow the business’s instructions.

faqs.question: Will my ticket carry over if the business closes?
faqs.answer: Some unresolved waiting tickets can continue once to a later queue day. Check the status and expiry shown on your ticket; not every final ticket status can carry over.

faqs.question: Will I always receive an email or browser alert?
faqs.answer: No. Delivery depends on your preferences, contact details, and device or browser support. The ticket page remains the place to check current status.

faqs.question: Is my booking confirmed as soon as I submit it?
faqs.answer: Not necessarily. Follow the status on your booking page and wait for confirmation from the business.

faqs.question: Does a confirmed booking automatically join the queue?
faqs.answer: No. The business may check you in and place you into the live queue when you arrive.

faqs.question: Does uploading payment proof confirm my booking?
faqs.answer: No. It records the information for the business to review. Check the booking status for the business’s decision.

faqs.question: Who processes my booking refund?
faqs.answer: Contact the business that received the payment. Manual booking refunds are handled by the business under the applicable terms.

faqs.question: Can I use email instead of my authenticator app?
faqs.answer: If Email OTP is enabled alongside your authenticator app, the sign-in screen can offer an option to send a code to your account email.

faqs.question: Should I share my sign-in code with support?
faqs.answer: No. Never share an authenticator code, email OTP, password, or recovery code. GetPrio support does not need these to help you.

faqs.question: How do I request deletion of my customer account?
faqs.answer: Sign in, open Account details, and use the account deletion option. Read the effects and outstanding-activity notice before submitting.

faqs.question: Does uninstalling the app delete my account?
faqs.answer: No. Uninstalling the app does not submit an account deletion request. Use the account deletion option in your account settings.

faqs.question: Will account deletion cancel my bookings or refund payments?
faqs.answer: No. Account deletion does not automatically cancel bookings or issue refunds. Contact the business about existing bookings and payments.

faqs.question: Who should I contact about a booking or visit?
faqs.answer: Contact the business for availability, schedule changes, payment review, and visit-specific questions. Contact GetPrio for account or app issues.

faqs.question: What should I include when asking for payment help?
faqs.answer: Include the business and booking or ticket reference, payment date, and reference shown in your records. Do not send passwords, one-time codes, or full card details.

faqs.question: Does GetPrio hold or send group-campaign money?
faqs.answer: No. Contributions are arranged between customers. GetPrio records submissions and decisions but does not hold or distribute campaign funds.

faqs.question: Are group-campaign reimbursements automatic?
faqs.answer: No. If a reimbursement is due, the organizer arranges it directly with the contributor. Confirm receipt only after the money arrives.
